hook.text: Cassandra stores billions of rows across hundreds of nodes. It was built for scale at Facebook.

buildup.text: Wide-column databases organize data by row key, then partition columns into column families.

discovery.text: They handle massive write throughput because writes are append-only and distributed across nodes.

twist.text: You must design your schema around your query patterns. Changing queries later means redesigning tables.

climax.text: Wide-column databases are the workhorses behind time-series data, IoT events, and messaging platforms.

punchline.text: Designed for massive writes and query-driven schemas.

quiz.question: What are wide-column databases best at?
options: High write throughput across distributed nodes
